# The scored set's sources: one `id url` per line, `#` comments allowed.
#
# `make enrich-record` captures each page through Harbor's own fetch and extract
# and writes testdata/saves/<id>.json. `labels.json` is the owner's file: it
# gets a blank entry for every capture and is never overwritten.
#
# A capture that production would refuse is a capture failure, not a case: a PDF,
# a JSON endpoint or a bot-walled 403 never becomes a scored save. The PDF the
# phase-3 demo names belongs to the exit demo (the item exists, with an amber
# "couldn't fetch" strip), not here.
#
# Two kinds are deliberately absent and cannot be captured: `note` has no page
# by definition, and `tweet` has no server-rendered page without x.com auth. The
# set covers ten of the twelve.
#
# The spread is the point: five languages, long-form and link-heavy fronts, repos
# and papers and shops, two video hosts, member-walled reporting (404 Media),
# and the Guardian's registration wall standing in for a paywalled teaser — the
# sites that actually paywall (FT, WSJ, NYT, The Economist) answer 403 to a plain
# fetch, so production cannot save them either.

# article — reference, long-form and front pages
